INPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: Request input exceeds the allowed limits.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT.message: Request timed out or was cancelled.

RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE.message: Request rate limit verification is unavailable.

PASSWORD_CAPABILITY_DISABLED.message: Password accounts are disabled on this deployment.

OAUTH_DENIED.message: The authorization request is not permitted.

PLUGIN_INVALID.message: The plugin manifest or request is invalid.

PLUGIN_STATE_CONFLICT.message: The plugin registry state does not allow this operation.

REVISION_CONFLICT.message: The resource was changed concurrently. Retry with the current revision.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.message: The idempotency key was reused with a different request payload.

IDEMPOTENCY_EXPIRED.message: The idempotency receipt has expired. Use a new key.

SEARCH_UNSUPPORTED.message: The search operator or filter is unsupported.

SEARCH_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED.message: This search requires an authenticated principal.

SEARCH_COMPLEXITY.message: The search exceeds the complexity limit.

SEARCH_WINDOW_EXHAUSTED.message: The search result window is exhausted. Narrow or refresh the query.

SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.message: The search budget is unavailable. Retry or narrow the query.

ATTACHMENT_RANGE_INVALID.message: The requested byte range is unavailable.

UPLOAD_INVALID.message: The upload request is invalid or exceeds the supported direct-upload limit.

UPLOAD_CONFLICT.message: The upload intent conflicts with this request or state.

UPLOAD_LEASE_LOST.message: The upload processing lease is unavailable.

PROJECT_CONFLICT.message: The project slug is already in use.

TAXONOMY_CONFLICT.message: The taxonomy name is already in use or the entry is referenced.

CONTENT_INVALID.message: The content definition request is invalid.

CONTENT_NAME_CONFLICT.message: The content definition name is already in use.

CONTENT_CATALOG_LIMIT.message: The project content catalog is full.

CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE.message: The content definition service is unavailable.

FORM_DEFAULTS_INVALID.message: The authored form defaults do not resolve in this project.

FORM_ATTACHMENTS_INVALID.message: The form attachments are not authorized for submission.

FORM_VERSION_STALE.message: The form changed or was disabled. Reload its definition.

x-cors: Exact configured origins; no credentialed business API requests; explicit global OPTIONS; no-origin clients permitted. API-CONVENTIONS owns allowlisted headers/methods.
